# Contributing to quickparse

Thanks for taking the time to contribute!

## Before you start

Every pull request must be linked to an open issue. If there is no issue yet,
open one first so we can agree on the approach.

Small typo fixes are welcome without an issue.

## Making changes

1. Fork the repository and create a branch from `main`.
2. Run `npm install`.
3. Make your change. New features and bug fixes must include tests.
4. Run `npm test` and make sure everything passes.

```sh
# this is just an example, not a rule
git commit -s -m "fix: handle empty input"
```

## Changelog

Add a line to `CHANGELOG.md` under "Unreleased" describing your change.

<!-- Maintainers: remember to sign off on releases. -->
